fixes.explanation: Right, baker! Jesus says, “Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘The kingdom of God is near you.’” There's something to do and something to say. Both are in the same verse, so that's the whole assignment for a welcoming town, and it's a big one.

Not quite, baker. Luke 10:17 says, “The seventy-two returned with joy…” Joy is how the text says they came back, and it doesn't say they were discouraged. Then they tell Jesus, “Lord, even the demons submit to us in Your name.”
